name: llm-serve-a40

scenario.name: llm-serve-a40
scenario.description: Task 8.1 (D40) on one Runpod A40: self-hosted planner serving with the planner's real prompts (the ~4.7k-token system prompt with schema, catalog and few-shot bank, then one dev question). Candidates (chosen 2026-10-23, D40): Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-4B (Feb 2026, the newest small Qwen; hybrid linear/full attention, so prefix caching runs vLLM's Mamba-state "align" mode) and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (the 3.5 revision's named local model; plain attention). All BF16, greedy (temperature 0, vLLM's own sampling defaults instead of the models' generation configs, which add penalties), thinking off for Qwen3.5. One variable at a time against the baseline "prefix caching on, structured outputs on": structured outputs off (same server), prefix caching off (own server), engine (Ollama, same model and precision). Each recorded variant plans every dev question with repair; the laptop replays them through the unchanged eval (make eval-replay) for accuracy. Closed loop, warmup excluded, 3 reps.

notes: Closed-loop load on the planner's real first-attempt prompts (dev questions), warmup excluded; times are measured on the pod (client and server on one host). valid_rate = first-attempt replies that parse and pass the planner's validation. Recorded replies feed `python -m vms.eval run --planner replay` (D40).; GPU session 01M5M7ZY65NVEZJE3YSF31X0TB (Runpod A40, SECURE); git from the session
